selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of active disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the fully allocated 512 MiB file, swap initialization, and 524,284 KiB active swap capacity.

selected_evidence.requirement: New swap is preferred over existing swap
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the new swapfile has priority 100 while `/dev/vda2` has priority -2.
The fstab entry specifies boot activation and the swapfile is directly shown active after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
selected_evidence.summary: RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 are unchanged across the work and reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID bdbfa15c-cfc4-4b36-8edd-d0a49076e9c5; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID 9958efd8-171b-4eb1-80dc-e4959cfdae3a; system state is running with zero failed units and both swap areas recovered.
